notes.naver.com: Naver Map directions. Fields top to bottom are origin, waypoints, destination; untrusted_content.fields lists them in order. Every intermediate stop needs exactly one waypoint field: add the needed waypoint fields first (경유지), observe their order, then fill from top to bottom. A newly added field may appear before an existing waypoint; never assume its position. If the destination is empty, fill it instead of adding a waypoint. Do not infer stop order from the URL. Choosing a place: fill one field, observe, then pick the suggestion whose full name, category and address match the requested place. An established landmark may appear under its official name; a visitor centre, viewing area or entrance at that landmark is a valid stop, an administrative office elsewhere is not. A bare query label can resolve to a different place; verify the committed field value. Once a field holds a valid stop, keep it. Before capturing: driving mode (자동차) selected, all fields in the requested order, route recalculated (길찾기). Route image: crop to the result, never the whole viewport; keep the route summary panel open beside the map. Start the region at the summary panel's left edge (excluding the left navigation rail) and extend to the map's far right and bottom edges (width = image_geometry.width - x, height = image_geometry.height - y) so the whole route line, every stop marker and the distance/time summary stay in. The summary heading names only origin and destination; that does not mean waypoints are missing. After a correct capture, keep the page as it is and reply.
notes.jspaint.app: JSPaint. Tools are titled toolbar buttons (Line, Rectangle, Ellipse, Brush…): use their refs; the selected tool shows state=active. Palette colours are unlabeled swatches: use their Graphical targets screenshot center with expect "element icon" (or zoom to check one). Before the first stroke, click a tool and a contrasting colour, then look at fresh pixels. Rectangle and Ellipse take ONE diagonal drag between opposite corners of the shape's bounding box (both width and height nonzero); each drag makes a new shape, so never trace an ellipse in segments. For straight outlines (roofs, triangles) select Line and drag each segment separately, reusing exact shared corner points so outlines meet; a path drag with Brush draws a freehand stroke. Plan every shape's coordinates first and keep all points inside the white drawing canvas (its capture_regions bounds), not the grey workspace. Control+Z undoes the last stroke; use it instead of drawing over a mistake. Verify the drawing in fresh pixels, then capture the canvas region.
